description: This file defines a Perl controller class for managing FAQ entries in an admin interface, including actions for listing, creating, editing, and updating FAQs.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Admin::FAQ
classes.description: Perl controller class for admin FAQ management, extending Coocook::Controller.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the list of FAQs, including URLs for editing each FAQ and creating new FAQs.

methods.name: new_faq
methods.description: Displays the form for creating a new FAQ.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures a specific FAQ by ID for subsequent actions like edit or update.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Displays the edit form for a specific FAQ.

methods.name: update_or_create
methods.description: Performs the actual database update or insert for FAQ data.
